item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
The Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework is now generally available for C# and Python. It supports agents, multi-agent orchestrations, and workflows that can run reliably for minutes, days, or weeks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Build Your Own AI Agent Harness in C#, the MafClaw Live Series
item.description:
Microsoft is running a 4-part live series showing how to build a C# AI agent harness with Microsoft Agent Framework, starting from a single IChatClient call and evolving it into a production-ready agent with observability and governance. The post is an announcement for the series and does not include technical implementation details.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: From dotnet run to Foundry Hosted Agent in 3 lines of C#
item.description:
Microsoft says an agent built with Microsoft Agent Framework can be deployed to Foundry Hosted Agent with 1 NuGet package, 3 lines of C#, and 2 commands.

  • Source: .NET
